L7CHECK
Description
These commands are valid for APM and the SSL Orchestrator.
Commands
L7CHECK::protocol
- allows you to set
or retrieve L7 protocol value
Events
L7CHECK_CLIENT_DATA
- triggered
each time new ingress data is received from client
L7CHECK_SERVER_DATA
- triggered
each time new ingress data is received from server
